resources.string: Devices must configure a proxy manually

Enable Allow LAN, set a fixed sharing port (for example 7890), and use 0.0.0.0 as the bind address. The current port is kept on first entry, or 7890 is used if no port is available. Leave this page to save; switching or updating profiles will then keep the sharing port. On the connected device, configure an HTTP or SOCKS proxy using this phone’s hotspot or LAN IP address and the fixed port. The phone’s system assigns the hotspot IP; the bind address cannot pin it. Start Clash and select Rule or Global mode. Only traffic sent to the proxy follows that mode. Authentication uses username:password entries.
Enter a port number from 1 to 65535
Proxy settings for the other device

IP address:
%1$s

SOCKS port: %3$s
Choose the IP for the network shared with the other device. Leave this page to save the ports independently of profiles.
No LAN address found. Enable the hotspot or connect to Wi-Fi, then reopen this page.
